summary.plain: A now-closed German nuclear power plant on the Elbe river that hosted the CONUS reactor-neutrino experiment from 2018 until the setup moved to Switzerland in 2023.
summary.technical: Brokdorf Nuclear Power Plant (KBR), Schleswig-Holstein, Germany; 3.9 GWth / 1440 MWe boiling water reactor, shut down 2021-12-31 as part of Germany's nuclear phase-out; hosted the CONUS CEvNS experiment 17.1 m from the reactor core.
